title: Add time-series stats CLI and storage integration coverage
description: Add separate CLI and flat-file integration tests for created and progressed output. Use the injected execution timestamp to avoid wall-clock flakes. Cover 7d-0d, 14d-7d, exact start/end boundaries, zero days, tasks outside the range, future values, and tasks whose CreatedAt and UpdatedAt fall into different buckets. Validate plain text, chart output, and the complete JSON range/bucket structure. Exercise malformed, reversed, equal, overflowing, missing, and extra ranges. Confirm stats reads do not mutate .wtp, task files, indexes, timestamps, or handoffs. Avoid duplicating lower-level aggregation cases; make only narrow fixes and run go test ./... plus git diff --check.
